svg.title: THE RESIDENT
svg.desc: The exact stepped ghost from the entrance banner uses a laptop in a dark haunted garage with a black cat, cracked stone, cobwebs, spider and pumpkins. The outer back of the laptop lid faces the viewer. The ghost blinks; candle flames and carved pumpkin light flicker while the wax and orange skins stay still. building something pretty useless in my garage. sometimes it even works.
